items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: I took a trip to Chicago to see my uncle Nat

ctx.x: We once talked about being stranded. If you did lose all your money and all that. There was a German man you would wire for money?

No, I know what you're referring to. This was in Texas. That was in East Bernard. I can't recall his name right now. But not being stranded. He was a friend of mine. He told me whenever you need something, just wire it. But now the time that I actually was stranded was when I was with this Chauncey Holland or Al Travis I think. It was in a little town in Carbondale, Illinois. And there was an old lady there, another lady. She liked me and she liked the band. So we were living with her and we didn't have another…
And you did make out when you got the money somehow?
